why: Every library entry the first engine holds and the second does not, as name/arity, each with the reason. Read by scripts/check-manifests.mjs, which compares the two manifests on every build and fails on a gap this file does not record, on a recorded gap that has closed, and on a row with no reason. The list only shrinks. A program calling one of these is refused by the second engine at load with OS6004, which is honest, and the second engine claims the strategy profile, which covers every one of them: issue 0021 is the record of that claim, and it closes when this list is empty.
